verdict.rationale: E2B is sandbox/code-execution infrastructure that agents and LLMs call as a tool (e.g., docs describe connecting LLMs to E2B, or running agents like Claude Code inside E2B sandboxes), not an AI agent/assistant that itself would consume external tools via MCP client integration. The evidence never shows E2B acting as an MCP client plugging in external tool servers, consistent with this being a category mismatch rather than a missing feature.
